title: Kiprun Kipsummit Men's Trail Running Shoes
body_html:
The perfect shoe for tackling climbs, hurtling down descents and enjoying every mile of your trail runs up to 26 miles.

  • Cushioning: Soft foam that absorbs impact and softens every stride
  • Traction: 4 mm lugs and a sturdy sole for reliable grip on all trails
  • Shock protection: Built-in toe cap to protect your feet from obstacles on the trails.

title: Kiprun Kipsummit Max Men's Trail Running Shoes
body_html:
Maximum shock absorption: Your ally for beating the miles and conquering long-distance trails without compromising on comfort.

  • Cushioning: Max absorption, ultimate comfort: next-level foam.
  • Comfortable fit: Maximum comfort thanks to the foam collar, tongue and upper.
  • Grip: Equipped with a Vibram outsole for optimal stability.
  • Energy return: Fastech+: Responsive foam that provides ultimate energy return.

title: Kiprun Kipsummit Race Women's Carbon Plate Trail Running Shoes
body_html:
Designed for high performance on trail runs ranging from 40 km to 170 km. This model particularly shines on rolling terrain in the mountains.

  • Energy return: Patented carbon plate and Fastech + technology to maximise explosive boost
  • Cushioning: SCF Foam, 100% ATPU, for great propulsion combined with excellent cushioning
  • Lightweight: 255 g (8)
  • Grip: Vibram Megagrip Litebase for unrivalled grip
  • Traction: 'Vibram Traction Lug' sole with 4 mm lugs
